October is Breast Cancer Awareness Month!

Let’s come together to raise awareness about breast cancer, honor those affected, and promote early detection. Did you know that regular screenings can significantly increase the chances of successful treatment? 

Let’s spread the word; early detection saves lives! 

So you have a survivor story? If so, I’d love to hear it! Share in the comments! 💖 #BreastCancerAwareness #EarlyDetection #SupportAndSurvive

Congratulations to our very own Pragathi Kasani-Akula from @SouthForsythHS on being selected by the White House as one of this year’s Girls Leading Change Honorees!  Following her mom’s breast cancer diagnosis, she developed a low-cost, less-invasive test to detect triple negative breast cancer early. Her research has been recognized by the Department of Defense at the National Junior Science and Humanities Symposium! 

Your service to make our world a better place in healthcare and your passion to raise over $20,000 in funds which was donated to food banks across the country represents the very best of America. I look forward to continuing to celebrate all of your success!

It was great to meet with some outstanding student leaders from the Medical College of Georgia. I look forward to working with them as we make healthcare better for every Georgian. https://t.co/gDO792K8JF
Always honored to work to make healthcare more affordable for our Servicemen and Veterans!

TODAY, I voted YES on H.R. 27, the HALT Fentanyl Act, which @RepMGriffith and @boblatta introduced.

As an ER physician, I have seen firsthand what fentanyl does to the body. I have treated too many young patients who have overdosed, and America has lost too many lives to this crisis. This was a no-brainer to vote yes to HALT Fentanyl.
RFK is not here to be a political activist, he’s here to protect the individual rights of the American people in healthcare. As a physician, that’s something I can get behind! https://t.co/iTv8DIdSDb

My district team had the pleasure of meeting with Georgia Highlands Medical Services, a private non-profit community health center. As a physician, I know firsthand what it takes to care for others and am thankful for the care Georgia Highlands provides to the constituents of GA07. I am honored to have been awarded the Distinguished Community Health Center Advocate Award.

Honored to celebrate 50 incredible years of my alma mater, Morehouse School of Medicine! As Student Body President in 2009/2010, I’m proud to see that their commitment to excellence thrives. Here's to 50 more years of impact, innovation, and success! https://t.co/LBNTzEEx0L

I am thrilled that Fulton County named April Morehouse School of Medicine Month! As a proud alum and former student body president, Morehouse holds a special place in my heart. It's where I honed my skills as a physician and reinforced the importance of serving our community. Morehouse's commitment to excellence in medicine continues to inspire me every day!

I was incredibly impressed by the young innovators who won the Congressional App Challenge in my district. Their app, Plot AI, uses data analytics, photo imaging, and AI to help farmers monitor crop health, forecast yields, and diagnose diseases—boosting efficiency and cutting costs.

Plot AI stands out because it focuses on real-world farm management and its potential to impact more than one community.

Congratulations to the team! I’m excited to see where they take Plot AI next.

It was a pleasure to join the AFP’s American Potential Podcast today. We had the opportunity to talk about some GOP healthcare solutions that exist now to increase access and save taxpayer dollars. Look out for the full episode coming soon! @AFPGeorgia https://t.co/SiDiPnUNlA

I’m proud to be a cosponsor of H.R. 2240, the Improving Law Enforcement Officer Safety and Wellness Through Data Act. This bipartisan, common sense legislation strengthens protections for our frontline heroes by enhancing data collection. I am thrilled to announce that it PASSED the House yesterday! I will continue to work tirelessly to protect those who put their lives on the line daily.

As I have stated many times before, we are out of time to do the right thing. Putting off Medicaid reform for 4 years is irresponsible and unnecessary. Putting off essential cuts to bloated government spending is a dereliction of duty. It is a time for choosing…
